tor.text: Chainer finds the Mirari outside Cabal City and hands it to the First, who is impressed by his loyalty.
The First makes the Mirari the prize of the Cabal Anniversary Games, and sacrifices Skellum in the pits, devastating Chainer.
Chainer then disarms the First, fails to kill him, banishes him to Aphetto, and takes control of the Cabal.
